column2: Paano i-decompose ang application sa microservices?
column4: hatiin ayon sa business domains: bawat service ay may sariling database at API

column2: Ano ang synchronous vs asynchronous communication?
column4: synchronous: HTTP/gRPC, naghihintay ng response. asynchronous: message queues, fire-and-forget.
single entry point, rate limiting, authentication, load routing — hindi direktang i-access ang services
ang mekanismo kung paano nagko-connect ang mga services: DNS-based, registry, o client-side

column2: Paano i-handle ang distributed transactions sa microservices?
column4: gamitin ang Saga pattern o eventual consistency sa halip na ACID transactions
